assumptions.statement: Official detailed planning controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire access, heritage limits, and engineering constraints are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: All intensity, height, setback, implementation, and parcel-specific renewal conclusions remain conceptual and must be confirmed by a professional team.

assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are repository-maintained rough geometry derived from public announcement text, location clues, and announced area values.
assumptions.impact: Use for intake and visualization only; replace all downstream geometry and metrics when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: AI public-space scenarios use data minimization, authorization, explainability, human review, appeal, and exit mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: No individual tracking or mandatory data collection is treated as necessary for the concept.

assumptions.statement: Field observations, confirmed permits, appointed named operators, procurement quotations, and professional sign-offs are all zero at submission time.
assumptions.impact: Every pilot remains HOLD until the 30-day baseline and gate evidence in visual/assets/delivery_contracts.json are completed.

assumptions.statement: S and M resource bands are planning-order comparisons, not quotations, budgets, or funding commitments.
assumptions.impact: Procurement, quantities, prices, approvals, and funding require a formal professional process.

assumptions.statement: The rough key-area polygon for Dazhongsi may not resolve every location clue raised in repository Issue #1029.
assumptions.impact: No site-specific implementation or investment decision may rely on that polygon before official boundary confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The 2026-08-25 OpenStreetMap/Overpass snapshot is incomplete volunteered geographic context and may be stale or geometrically inconsistent.
assumptions.impact: Use only to make street, rail, water, green and building relationships legible; prohibit it from official boundaries, statutory controls, ownership, demolition, precise capacity, or approval decisions.
